feature_strategy: V1 base order-time features: customer profile, product, price, channel, payment, promotion, and logistics expectation.
V2 customer temporal history: V1 plus point-in-time customer return/spend/order behavior and rolling windows.
interpretation: Adds stronger customer/history and engineered behavior features.

feature_strategy: V3 product and logistics risk: V2 plus product/category/brand/courier point-in-time risk and quality/logistics scores.
interpretation: Adds broader risk features and selected interactions.

feature_strategy: V4 business interactions: V3 plus category-payment-channel-province interactions, bands, and risk flags.
interpretation: High-signal best candidate with the strongest combined feature set in this benchmark.

feature_strategy: V5 compact selected best: reduced feature set selected from V2-V4 to keep performance high while reducing noise/resource use.
interpretation: Compact/reduced candidate used to check whether fewer features can keep performance close.
